name: United Overseas Bank (UOB) Singapore

scam_info.sample: Scam alert: 30 Apr 2026 Investment Scam Be vigilant against online investment scams, particularly ads that claim guaranteed returns and appear to be endorsed by or coming from our staff.
scam_info.notes: 'Scam Alerts' section: 19 alert blocks headed 'Scam alert: <dates>' (many re-issued on several dates; newest 28 Aug 2026, oldest May 2024). Narrative only - no fake domains/numbers. 14 May 2024 item gives allowlist rule: 'verify ... if the web domain comes from "uob.com.sg" or "uobgroup.com"'. Mentions authorised seller link kkday.me/WaterbombUOB (official partner, not scam). Earlier survey thought it undated - it is dated.

scam_info.sample: Always access UOB services through the UOB TMRW app or official website. If unsure, call our Fraud Hotline at 6255 0160 and activate Money Lock in the UOB TMRW app
scam_info.notes: UOB Security hub with 'Latest Alerts' cards (same alerts as news page, undated cards) and links: How UOB protects you, Security Tips, Changes to SMS Alerts, Report Scam.

scam_info.sample: Contact our dedicated 24/7 Fraud Hotline at 6255 0160 and press "1" to report a case
scam_info.notes: Short link redirects to https://www.uob.com.sg/personal/digital-banking/pib/security/what-to-do-if-you-have-been-scammed/index.page (step-by-step: lock cards in TMRW, kill switch, fraud hotline options 1/3). Not an online form.

hotlines: 6255 0160 (UOB dedicated 24/7 Fraud Hotline; press 1 to report a case, 3 to block cards)

notes: official_domains: uob.com.sg and uobgroup.com are (a) - explicitly named as the authentic UOB Singapore web domains in the 14 May 2024 scam alert. uob.com (b): go.uob.com short links on UOB pages redirect to uob.com.sg. uobam.com.sg (UOB Asset Management login secure.uobam.com.sg), uobkayhian.com.sg, uoi.com.sg and other-market sites uob.com.my/.co.id/.co.th/.com.vn/uobchina.com.cn are (b) group links in homepage navigation; uobtravel.com/uobvm.com.sg/uobglobal.com also linked but not added. Login host pib.uob.com.sg. SMS sender ID not stated on pages read (changes-to-sms-alerts page fetched, no sender ID). ScamShield bank-hotline list: 'UOB Dial 6255 0160' (matches; ScamShield links UOB to uobgroup.com/uobgroup/contact-us/index.page). Robots.txt lists 10 sitemaps incl. uobgroup.com ones.
